name: Pale Fire Capital
decision_note: Prague technology-oriented private equity group investing its own long-term capital (typically hundreds of millions to over CZK 1bn per deal); active in 2026 but a PE investor, outside the VC pilot.

legal_entities.name: Pale Fire Capital investiční společnost a.s.
Pale Fire Capital Altira SICAV a.s.

evidence.quote: Pale Fire Capital SE je technologicky orientovaná private equity skupina s českými kořeny, založená v roce 2015 partnery se zkušenostmi z budování úspěšných technologických firem.
Naše investice se typicky pohybují ve stovkách milionů až přes miliardu korun vlastních prostředků.
Pale Fire Capital uzavřel rok 2025 s private equity portfoliem v hodnotě 10 miliard korun.
Pale Fire Capital, dosavadní majoritní vlastník ROUVY, zároveň získává ve Zwift významný podíl.

analyst_notes: Self-described technology-oriented private equity group (CVCA profile and own site) investing own capital, typically as majority/long-term owner (e.g. majority owner of ROUVY, sold to Zwift in April 2026 in exchange for a significant Zwift stake; plans minority stakes in CEE family companies). Typed pe with secondary private_investor; S1. Ticket 'hundreds of millions to over a billion CZK of own funds' (site, e2) has no exact bounds, so it is not filled. Portfolio value CZK 10bn at end-2025 (2026-07-02 release) is a valuation, not fund capital. The group also has a licensed investment company and SICAVs (Pale Fire Capital SICAV, Altira SICAV registered 2026) and issues bonds (Pale Fire Financing).
